description.en: 工业软件是先进工业知识与经验的凝炼，工业软件自身的先进性既来自对先进工业先进需求的汲取提炼，也来自对根技术新突破、新成果的高效采用。为增强根技术新成果提供方与工业软件厂家或最终用户方的连接，促进国产工业软件差异化竞争力的打造，数字化工业软件联盟将聚焦于CAGD、AI for CAX&AI Native 、Cloud for CAX & Cloud Native等技术领域发布工业软件新场景新技术难题，以广泛征集解题思路、并展开后续的创新项目申报。 （一）难题浏览 （1） 面向迈曦通用结构的薄壁结构智能创成计算算法研发 （2）面向嘉立创 EDA 基于 AI 的原理图设计审查的研究 （二）征集时间 2026年3月4日 至 2026年4月4日18:00（征集时间一个月） （三）征集流程 了解难题内容→获取解题参与详解说明及解题思路方案模板→解题思路方案准备→在规定时间内提交报名信息，并上传方案→方案预审核反馈及确认→内部评审解题思路方案 （四）报名及方案提交链接 https://jsj.top/f/SjRqfy （五）联系方式 联系人：杨淑娟 联系邮箱：yangshujuan@disa.org.cn 联系微信： （六）附件 附件1：解题参与说明 附件2：解题思路方案模板 更多内容详见难题发布合集

title: 华为算法挑战赛第36期-AI智算集群通信多平面编排难题

description.en: In recent years, large-scale AI models have rapidly empowered various industries, leading to an explosive growth in computing power demand that far exceeds the speed of performance improvements in individual computing cards. To meet this demand, it is essential to connect a large number of computing cards through high-performance networks. This competition is open to students, developers, corporate employees, and other technical professionals. Participants can enter individually; team participation is not required. Please note that the registration and submission period for entries runs from now until March 15, 2026.
description.zh: 近年来，大规模AI模型正快速赋能各行各业，算力需求呈爆炸式增长，远超单张算卡性能提升速度，必须依靠高性能网络将大量算卡互联以满足需求。本赛事面向在校学生、开发者、企业员工等科技人员开放报名。以单人形式参赛，无需组队。请注意，报名与作品提交时间均为即日起至2026年3月15日。

title: 华为算法挑战赛技术论坛

description.en: This forum, themed "Technological Foundations and Practical Exploration in the Era of Intelligence," brings together outstanding winners from previous competitions, industry experts, and leading figures in the IT sector. You will hear from champion participants on how they achieved key breakthroughs in cutting-edge topics such as memory management in large language models, and engage in in-depth discussions with technical experts to explore the practical applications of advanced technologies like intelligent agents and Ascend AI computing power in industrial scenarios.
description.zh: 本次论坛以“智能时代下的技术基础与实践探索”为主题，特邀往期赛事的杰出优胜者、产业赛题专家与各IT行业大咖领袖齐聚一堂。您将聆听到冠军选手如何在大语言模型记忆管理等尖端赛题中实现关键突破，并与技术专家深度对话，共同探讨Agent智能体、昇腾AI算力等前沿技术在工业场景的应用实践。

description.en: 2025 ICPC Challenge Championship powered by Huawei will be held at the Lianqiu Lake Campus in Shanghai. Jointly initiated by Huawei and ICPC, the Championship aims to enhance collaborative talent development and jointly promote industrial advancement and technology progress. Under the theme "Exploring Technology Foundation and Practice in the Era of Intelligence," this year's Championship will feature key segments such as the Challenge contest, Technology salons, and Previous Challenge Roadshows. Over 100 coaches, top programming contestants, academic professors, and industry experts from around the world will gather at the Lianqiu Lake Campus to collaboratively explore and solve challenging real-world industry problems, while also discussing future technology trends and key challenges.

Accelerate the integration of AI and the industry and improve developer capabilities.

description.en: Since the first algorithm contest in 2021 and the first AI algorithm contest in 2023 were held, the two contests have attracted many enthusiasts and experts inside and outside the company. To further improve algorithm capabilities, train and identify talent, create an atmosphere in which everyone learns AI and everyone understands AI, integrate AI with traditional industries, and solve industry challenges, the original algorithm contest and the original AI algorithm contest will be held together from 2025. The newly merged algorithm competition will be held from August to September 2025.
description.zh: 自2021年首届算法大赛、2023年首届AI算法大赛举办以来，两个大赛吸引了公司内外众多爱好者和专家的参与。为了进一步促进算法能力提升，锻炼和识别人才，营造人人学AI，人人懂AI的氛围，把AI与传统行业结合，解决产业难题，自2025年起原算法大赛和原AI算法大赛将合并举办，新合并的算法大赛将于2025年8月~9月举办。
